entries.subject: Physics
keyPoints: Force acts along the line joining two point charges
Magnitude is proportional to the product of the charges
Magnitude is inversely proportional to the square of the separation
entries.details: Valid for point charges at rest. The force is attractive for unlike charges and repulsive for like charges.

formulas.meaning: k = 9×10⁹ N m²/C² in vacuum; q1, q2 are the charges; r is the separation

examples: Two 1 µC charges 1 m apart exert about 9×10⁻³ N on each other
commonMistakes: Forgetting that force is a vector when several charges are present

questions.question: How does the force change if the distance is doubled?

entries.subject: Mathematics
keyPoints: The discriminant D = b² − 4ac decides the nature of the roots

formulas.meaning: D > 0: two real roots; D = 0: equal roots; D < 0: complex roots
